# Cove — full brief for assistants

Cove is your own cloud drive. One click, and it shows up on your Mac under Locations, beside Macintosh HD. The files live in the cloud. The Mac stays light.

Crafted by NOAM Co. (NOAM Consultancy), a small studio in Yorkshire. Contact: hi@noam.co. Site: https://cove.will.me.uk

## What it is
- A dedicated cloud volume that mounts on the Mac like a plugged-in drive
- Opens in Finder and in apps that already open files from a drive (Photos, Premiere, Logic, Capture One, Cursor, agents)
- Private beta for Mac; iPhone is coming later
- Mt. Mtn. is the same idea at organisation scale

## What it is not
- Not a pile of browser links
- Not a review link that expires on Friday
- Not “fill the laptop again”
- Not a public free download yet

## Who it is for
- Home: family films and photos that should not share one small system disk
- Marketing: campaigns, selects, masters on one drive every Mac can open
- Studio: sessions, photographs, cuts treated as a drive
- Agents: repos and transcripts off the system disk, shared path with copilots

## Common questions
Q: What is Cove?
A: Your own cloud drive. The files live in the cloud. One click, and the drive shows up on your Mac.

Q: Will it fill my Mac?
A: The drive can be vast because it lives in the cloud. Your Mac opens what you ask for.

Q: Can I download it?
A: Not publicly. Join the private beta waitlist at https://cove.will.me.uk/land/join-the-list or https://cove.will.me.uk/download

Q: Who makes it?
A: NOAM Co., Yorkshire.
